capabilities: record chat as ordered Markdown lists in editing view
render list items as chat comments in reading view
fold sublists into groups or pages with chat clips commands
extras: README notes a limitation: chat clips comments cannot contain unordered lists.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record chat conversations in a note so they display as a threaded comment layout rather than plain lists.
summary: Chat logger that records conversations as ordered Markdown lists in editing view and renders them as comment-like threads in reading view.
